instruction.name: xvsra.w
instruction.description: Arithmetic right shift each signed 32-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element of `b` modulo 32, store the result in `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvsra.w $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvsra.w $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvsra.w $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvsra.w $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvsra.w $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvsra.w $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvsra.w $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvsra.w $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
